title: Tech Note: Applying and Managing Styles in 4D Write Pro
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: WP SET ATTRIBUTES / WP GET ATTRIBUTES
4D Write Pro object notation for range attributes
WP New style sheet (character vs paragraph)
wk style sheet / wk font bold style constants
4D Write Pro ranges and elements (headers, footers, tables, paragraphs)

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write Pro's attribute/range/style-sheet model described here remains the current, unchanged way to procedurally style documents in 4D, since 4D Write Pro (unlike classic 4D Write) continues to be actively developed; the object-notation vs. command-based dual API contrast shown is still accurate today.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro's document/range/style attribute model (WP SET/GET ATTRIBUTES, style sheets) remains the current, standard API with no architectural replacement
Using bracket notation with wk-prefixed constants for object-notation attribute access is still the recommended safer style over hardcoded dot-notation property names
